name: Honda VTX1300
engine: 1312 cc liquid-cooled V-twin, carb, shaft drive
intro: Honda's mid-size power cruiser. Simple to own. Check the fuel valve recall on 2007-2008 bikes.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2007-2008 VTX1300s were in recall 08V141 because the fuel control valve diaphragm can drip fuel.
A-002.reason: Leaking fuel is a fire risk. The repair is free.

recalls.what: Fuel control valve diaphragm may drip fuel.
